structured_output.what_is_happening: A "merci" token (HE3s…) launched on a Meteora virtual curve and moved to pumpswap about 11 minutes before detection. It went up 350-410% on about $255k of volume. It is one of at least 10 same-name "merci" tokens launched in the same ~15 minutes. The project site (merciszn.fun) describes a Pump.fun-based cat/"thank you" callout mechanic. This token's own metadata description points to a different mint, 9NPm…pump. That mint launched ~10 minutes earlier, has twice the liquidity ($55k) and $597k h1 volume. So this token is most likely a ticker hijack of the canonical pump.fun merci.

narrative.description: $merci: 'crime rearranged into gratitude', merci cat PFP, holders who wear the cat PFP get creator fees from callouts. This is a pump.fun community meme mechanic.
narrative.why_spreading: A fresh pump.fun meme with a participation mechanic (PFP switching). The flood of copycat mints shows the name is getting attention, but that attention belongs to the canonical 9NPm…pump token.

token_connection.why_this_token: It copies the name and links to the canonical project's X status and site. Its own metadata description points to the 9NPm…pump mint. The site says the project is built on Pump.fun, but this token came from a Meteora virtual curve, not pump.fun.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 9NPmnDgL…9pump (earliest, $359k mcap, $55k liq, $597k h1 vol, likely canonical), plus ~9 other merci clones, several already drained to ~$0 liquidity

authenticity.evidence: 1,830 unique buyers against only 89 sellers, and GMGN tags 38 bundler wallets. RugCheck finds a 39-wallet insider trade network. Many same-name clones have already been drained, which is a typical clone-farm pattern. No paid DexScreener boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: X posts could not be checked. Buyers may be confusing this token with the canonical one, or the buys may be bot-driven.

structural_risks: One unlabeled wallet holds 80.05% of supply (possibly the Meteora/DBC pool, but unverified)
RugCheck: 99.98% of LP unlocked (danger); low number of LP providers
Clone of a canonical token that has twice the liquidity
Sibling clones already drained to ~$0 liquidity

structured_output.counterargument: The buyer count is large: 1,830 unique buyers against 89 sellers. If the canonical merci keeps running, overflow buyers may push a cheaper clone up 2x. GMGN reports an lp_burn_ratio of 1.0, which conflicts with RugCheck. The 80% holder could simply be the curve pool, so actual holder concentration may be modest.

The LP-lock conflict between RugCheck (unlocked) and GMGN (burned)

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a likely non-canonical clone of a hot pump.fun meme. The canonical token has more liquidity, and sibling clones are being drained. Other risks are unlocked LP, bundlers, and an 80% holder. Its chance of running is below average and its rug risk is high.
